text: Artificial intelligence is rapidly changing our world, but it also brings serious ethical challenges. One major concern is bias: AI systems learn from data that may contain human prejudices, leading to unfair outcomes in areas like hiring or lending. Fairness requires careful design and constant testing to ensure everyone is treated equally. Privacy is another key issue, as AI often collects vast amounts of personal information, so clear rules are needed to protect people's data. Transparency matters too—users should understand how decisions are made, especially when AI affects their lives. Ultimately, responsible AI development means putting ethics first, not just speed or profit. By focusing on these principles, we can build technology that helps everyone without causing harm.
